title: Kth Smallest Element
statement:
Given an unsorted array of N integers and a value K, find the Kth smallest element in the array.

The Kth smallest element is the element that would be at index K-1 if the array were sorted in ascending order.
inputFormat:
The first line contains N and K.
The second line contains N space-separated integers.
outputFormat: A single integer: the Kth smallest element.
